title: 병원에서 증상 설명하기: 언제, 어떻게 아파요?
objective: You can tell a doctor how a pain feels and when it gets worse, using -을수록.
summary: A patient tells the doctor what hurts and when it gets worse.
setting: A small clinic (내과). A patient with a sore throat and cough explains the symptoms to the doctor.

task.title: Describe symptoms with -을수록
task.line: Use the dialogue and word list to fill in, choose, order, or answer in Korean.

words.meaning: to sting, to feel a sharp prickly pain
words.exampleMeaning: It stings when I put medicine on the cut.
I couldn't sleep, so my head is throbbing.
My face was puffy when I woke up.
I guess I overdid it at the gym yesterday.

words.meaning: the more ..., the more ... (after a consonant: -을수록, after a vowel or ㄹ: -ㄹ수록)
words.exampleMeaning: The more you rest, the faster the cough gets better.

dialogue.korean: 사흘 전부터 목이 아프고 기침이 나요. 밤이 될수록 기침이 심해져요.
dialogue.meaning: My throat has hurt and I've been coughing for three days. The later it gets at night, the worse the cough gets.

dialogue.korean: 어제 재 보니까 38도였어요. 그리고 침을 삼킬 때마다 목이 따끔거려요.
dialogue.meaning: I checked yesterday and it was 38 degrees. And my throat stings every time I swallow.
Do you have any other symptoms?

dialogue.korean: 콧물은 없는데 머리가 좀 지끈거려요. 말을 많이 할수록 목이 더 아프고요.
dialogue.meaning: No runny nose, but I have a bit of a throbbing headache. And the more I talk, the more my throat hurts.

dialogue.korean: 무리할수록 낫는 데 오래 걸리니까 이틀 정도는 푹 쉬세요.
dialogue.meaning: The more you push yourself, the longer it takes to get better, so rest well for about two days.

exercises: Fill in the blank with -을수록 (-ㄹ수록): 계단을 ____ (오르다) 무릎이 더 아파요.
Choose the right word: ① 바늘로 찌르는 것처럼 목이 (따끔거려요 / 지끈거려요). ② 어제 많이 울어서 눈이 (부었어요 / 삼켰어요). ③ 감기에 걸렸을 때는 (무리하지 / 푹 쉬지) 마세요.
Put the words in order to make one sentence: 심해져요 / 움직일수록 / 허리 통증이
Answer in Korean based on the dialogue: 환자는 어떨 때 목이 더 아파요? (-을수록 사용)
answers: ① 따끔거려요 ② 부었어요 ③ 무리하지
허리 통증이 움직일수록 심해져요. (움직일수록 허리 통증이 심해져요.)
말을 많이 할수록 목이 더 아파요.
